pages.about: Fielding Athletic supplies clubs, schools and recreational players. We started by kitting out a single youth league and now serve teams across the region. Bulk pricing is available on request for orders over twenty units.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in unused condition with original packaging and tags. Personalised or printed items are non-returnable unless faulty. Refunds within 5 business days of receipt.
pages.shipping_policy: Standard shipping $7.00, free over $100, delivered in 3-5 business days. Bulk club orders ship on a pallet service with a quoted lead time of 7-10 business days.
